scripts.pot:init: pnpm exec snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 12 pot12_0000.ptau
scripts.pot:contribute: pnpm exec snarkjs powersoftau contribute pot12_0000.ptau pot12_final.ptau --name="first contribution" -v
scripts.pot:prepare: pnpm exec snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 pot12_final.ptau build/pot12_final_phase2.ptau
scripts.setup: pnpm exec snarkjs groth16 setup build/demo.r1cs build/pot12_final_phase2.ptau build/demo_0000.zkey
scripts.contribute: pnpm exec snarkjs zkey contribute build/demo_0000.zkey build/demo_final.zkey --name="phase1" -v
scripts.export:vk: pnpm exec snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/demo_final.zkey build/verification_key.json
scripts.export:sol: pnpm exec snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier build/demo_final.zkey build/Verifier.sol
scripts.witness: corepack pnpm exec -- snarkjs wtns calculate build/demo_js/demo.wasm input.example.json build/witness.wtns
scripts.prove: pnpm exec snarkjs groth16 prove build/demo_final.zkey build/witness.wtns build/proof.json build/public.json
scripts.verify: pnpm exec snarkjs groth16 verify build/verification_key.json build/public.json build/proof.json
